note: Technical environment for this release. Personal, organisational and tool-specific fields present in the development notes are deliberately omitted; nothing here identifies a person or a machine by name.

board.python_tbe: 3.9.2 (Miniconda; NumPy 1.22.4, required by the ATC operator compiler)

original.used_for: all numbers reported in the paper

notes: atc is not on PATH until set_env.sh is sourced; under a non-login shell that script exits silently, so every board command must run under `bash -l`.
The ATC operator compiler needs a Python with NumPy on PATH; the board's system Python has NumPy 2.x, which the 9.1.1 TBE does not accept, hence the Miniconda interpreter.
Compilation peak resident set is 2.24-2.49 GB on a 3.4 GB board; builds complete only by using the 8 GB swap file.
atc prints 'ATC run success', writes the .om, then faults during exit (SIGBUS or SIGSEGV). The artefacts are valid; the acceptance test is load plus token-level correctness, never the exit status.

development_host.role: ONNX export, input generation, analysis and figure rendering only; no timing is taken here

boundary.note: used only to establish a residency boundary; reported at gamma=2 through the single-graph path
